script: Column names with trailing spaces. Dates formatted three different ways.
I spent two weeks on that dataset before I ran a single analysis.
Two weeks of Python loops that felt like archaeology — chipping away.

props.description: An archaeological dig metaphor for cleaning messy data. Layered strata of sediment slowly brush away to reveal a buried, glowing data grid underneath. Each pass of the brush exposes another stratum of garbage values dissolving, never quite sure if the clean data has been found yet. Earthy excavation tones giving way to a luminous structured table.

script: never sure if you'd found the actual data or just another layer of sediment.
